asset.description: The {@link ReliabilityAsset} for which the desired data was created

timestamp.description: The timestamp for the desired data

model.description:
The {@link ReliabilityMlModel} which generated the desired data. If not provided, will use the prediction
generated by the model which was live at the `timestamp` time.

isValidation.description:
Whether the risk score should be based on predictions made by models that are being validated.
If `true`, the risk score will be obtained using {@link ReliabilityRiskScoreMlValidationPrediction}.

title:
Information that pinpoints a single risk score (and associated feature contributions).
If `model` is specified, will get a {@link ReliabilityRiskScoreMlPrediction} specific to the provided
model; otherwise, will get the {@link ReliabilityRiskScoreMlPrediction} generated by the live
model at the time.
name: RiskScoreSpec
